chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about madhy that gets onto a garment. He said: “If you know its place, then wash it; and if its place is hidden from you, then wash the entire garment.”

key_terms.الثَّوْبَ: the garment or clothing affected by the substance
key_terms.الْمَذْيِ: pre-seminal fluid discussed here in the context of ritual impurity on clothing
key_terms.فَاغْسِلِ الثَّوْبَ كُلَّهُ: wash the entire garment when the precise spot is unknown
key_terms.مَكَانَهُ: the specific location of the impurity on the garment

ai.seo_question: What should be done if madhy gets on a garment and its exact place is unknown?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning impurity on clothing caused by madhy. It instructs that if the affected spot is known, only that place is washed, but if it is unknown, the entire garment is to be washed.
